title: Starfall Basket
menu.howto: Catch the falling stars with the basket. Miss three and the run is over.
menu.controls.pointer: Mouse or touch: move the basket.
menu.controls.keyboard: Keyboard: ← → or A D to move, P to pause.
pause.title: Paused
over.title: Game over
over.revive: Watch an ad: continue with 1 life
over.noReward: The ad was not finished, so there is no reward.
over.adUnavailable: No ad is available right now. Try again later.
